Kai (Eng): two quick questions after the town hall. 1) Should our public messaging lean into quantization/tech details or keep it high level? 2) how much emphasis on Dedicated vs Hosted in external comms?
Ava (CEO): keep public messaging high level. highlight outcomes: predictable latency, cost savings, and deployment flexibility. tech details belong in docs/benchmarks and product collateral.
Sam (VP Product): external: lead with Hosted as the easiest path for new users, then call out Dedicated/Private as options for scale and compliance.
Priya (Head of Research): note: when pushing tech details to docs, include caveats and clear reproducibility steps. we don't want misinterpreted microbenchmarks.
Jordan (Sales): from conversations: customers like seeing a short "how it works" appendix in decks. one image that shows routing, caching, and fallback helps.
Nia (Design): i'll make a one-slide visual for that architecture flow and hand it to Sam.
Kai (Eng): are we okay letting product own the short perf claims? want to make sure legal doesn't overpromise.
Ava (CEO): product owns messaging but loop in legal for any SLA or numeric promise.
notes-bot: (system) Note created: all-hands-followup/one-pager-messaging.md
Sam (VP Product): i'll draft the external one-pager and share next Tue. owners: Sam (lead), Priya (benchmarks), Nia (visuals), Jordan (AE feedback), Kai (tech review).
Priya (Head of Research): team ask: please funnel benchmark requests through the bench request form so we can prioritize.
Jordan (Sales): will do. thanks all.
Ava (CEO): thanks, short and actionable. :clap:
